posts.text:
If you ask anyone in Grand Rapids where to grab a hot dog, they’ll mention Yesterdog! They've won ✨Best Hot Dog in Grand Rapids✨ every year for the past THREE decades!

I was so excited to be at Yesterdog celebrating 50 years of good people, good memories, and good dogs 🌭

Pride is personal for me as a mom, a friend, a leader, and a Michigander. From signing the Elliot-Larsen Civil Rights Act with my daughter by my side to banning state funds for conversion therapy and establishing the first-ever statewide LGBTQ+ commission, we've got a lot done.

While I'm proud of our work building a Michigan for all, we can't slow down. As the LGBTQ+ community faces attacks, I am all gas no brakes on protecting LGBTQ+ Michiganders.

This proclamation is a reminder of what we've achieved and a commitment to the work ahead.

I’m so excited to be here at the expansion of La Colombe Coffee.

This expansion will strengthen our agricultural industry while creating over 300 new jobs, $567 million in investments, and put more milk from Michigan dairy farmers in lattes all across the country!

Michigan’s story is incomplete without the legacy of Black Michiganders.
 
As we gear up to celebrate Juneteenth later this month, let's all take time to recognize and honor the countless contributions of Black Michiganders who have made our state what it is today.

Every day, LGBTQ+ Michiganders make a difference in their communities. They guide us towards a future where everyone can thrive. I’m grateful I could kick off Pride Month with LGBTQ+ leaders who inspire me to keep building a better, more inclusive Michigan.

Happy Pride 🏳️‍🌈

Michigan is a state for everyone. I will always stand beside the LGBTQ+ community and protect our neighbors, loved ones, and friends. To every LGBTQ+ Michigander, you are welcomed and celebrated here!

Video

Right now, prices are rising on the essentials. Here in Michigan, we’ve made real progress to put more money in people’s pockets.

💰Cut over $1 billion in taxes
💰Cut taxes on tips, overtime, and social security
💰Delivered free pre-K and community college tuition-free

Women deserve informed care that acknowledges our specific needs.

It’s on all of us to bring women’s health to the forefront. Let’s build a Michigan where women’s health is led by honest conversations and reliable care.

Video
Raise your hand if you want to make free school meals permanent ✋

We choose Michigan and choose each other.

Let’s keep working together and continue building a Michigan for all.
When we work together, we find common ground. It may be harder, but it’s so worth it.

This year, we celebrate America’s 250th anniversary. I’m proud of our nation’s story, one that’s as beautiful and complicated and impressive as the people who call it home. I’m grateful to be an American every day, and I know that identity carries with it a responsibility.

Earlier this year, I set a clear goal: Every Child Reads. To support our long-term focus on literacy, I’m bringing leaders together to serve on our Every Child Reads Champions Council.
Literacy is a marathon, not a miracle. Our bipartisan work must continue after I leave office.

I can’t fix global inflation alone, but we can work together to give Michiganders relief. The budget I proposed includes:
✅ The largest property tax relief in decades
✅ Tax cuts on tips, overtime, & social security
✅ Sales tax holiday on school supplies 
✅ Protects Medicaid

Here in Michigan,
we protected every Michigander’s right to control their body
we protected every Michigander’s right to wear their natural hair
we protected every Michigander’s right to be who they are and love who they love
and we’re going to keep fighting to keep it that way.

2018: ran to fix the damn roads.
2020: launched Rebuilding Michigan, a five-year bond plan to fix our busiest state highways and bridges.
Last fall: negotiated the largest roads deal in state history, ramping up to invest an extra $2 billion a year to fix state and local roads.

Bipartisanship

🔊 bi·par·ti·san·ship
 Noun

1. The practice of working across differences to find common ground. 2. A commitment to collaboration even when the world feels so divided. 3. A reminder that algorithms, polarization, and mistrust don’t have to define us.

Today, I’ll deliver my 8th Mackinac Policy Conference Keynote Address.

Tune in at 4:10pm to join me in celebrating the state we choose to call home 👇

I just finished signing legislation to protect Selfridge Air National Guard Base in Macomb County. I couldn't have gotten this done without Senator Hertel, who has been fighting for this base and the jobs that support it for years. So glad we got it done!
